remarks:
Newly priced to offer exceptional value, this exceptional all-brick colonial is tucked away on a private cul-de-sac in the highly rated Williamsville Central School District. Offering a spacious 4,035 square feet with 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, and a 3.5-car garage, the home perfectly balances grand entertaining spaces with comfortable everyday living.
A welcoming two-story foyer with a curved staircase and soaring ceilings creates an immediate sense of scale. The main floor features tall ceilings and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the formal dining room, living room, and family room with natural light. A private first-floor den with built-in shelving offers a quiet retreat, while the massive two-story family room stands out with a dramatic wall of windows. The thoughtfully designed kitchen is equipped with granite countertops, a center island, ample storage, and newer stainless steel appliances, including a double oven and a premium GE Profile refrigerator with a built-in Keurig brewer. Essential modern conveniences include Central vacuum, a first-floor full bath with direct pool deck access and a whole-house generator for complete peace of mind.
Upstairs, a dramatic catwalk leads to four large bedrooms. The primary suite serves as a spacious retreat, featuring cathedral ceilings, excellent window placements, a generous walk-in closet, and an ensuite bath with a jetted tub. Outside, the property shines as an entertainer's dream, featuring an in-ground saltwater pool, a two-tiered deck, a gazebo, and a storage shed, all surrounded by mature landscaping. Combining wonderful amenities with a prime location close to all daily conveniences, this home offers an incredible value in today's market.
